cases.purpose: Check default groups and -G with split credentials, real GID absent or supplementary, equal IDs, and unnamed effective IDs. Also verify real/effective options and names.
cases.oracle: GNU coreutils id in reference Bash, same credential setup, Bash -p and private passwd/group fixtures.
cases.comparison: Byte parity and status with /proc identity and group snapshots; setup or command failure is a nonzero case status.
cases.script:
set -u
P=$PWD
cat > "$P/passwd.fx" <<'X'
root:x:0:0:root:/root:/bin/bash
alice:x:3001:3001:Alice:/tmp:/bin/bash
bob:x:3002:3002:Bob:/tmp:/bin/bash
X
cat > "$P/group.fx" <<'X'
root:x:0:
alice:x:3001:
bob:x:3002:
staff:x:4000:
wheel:x:4001:
X
/usr/bin/mount --bind "$P/passwd.fx" /etc/passwd || exit 97
/usr/bin/mount --bind "$P/group.fx" /etc/group || exit 97
run() {
  local label=$1 ru=$2 eu=$3 rg=$4 eg=$5 gs=$6
  echo "case=$label"
  /usr/bin/setpriv --ruid="$ru" --euid="$eu" --rgid="$rg" --egid="$eg" --groups="$gs" "$BASH" --noprofile --norc -p -c '
    want_ru=$1 want_eu=$2 want_rg=$3 want_eg=$4
    set -f
    while read -r tag a b rest; do
      case $tag in
        Uid:) [[ $a == "$want_ru" && $b == "$want_eu" ]] || exit 97;;
        Gid:) [[ $a == "$want_rg" && $b == "$want_eg" ]] || exit 97;;
      esac
    done < /proc/$BASHPID/status
    while IFS= read -r line; do case $line in Uid:*|Gid:*|Groups:*) echo "$line";; esac; done < /proc/$BASHPID/status
    for q in "id" "id -a" "id -ru" "id -u" "id -rg" "id -g" "id -G"; do
      out=$($q 2>&1); rc=$?; printf "%s => %s (rc=%s)\n" "$q" "$out" "$rc"
      (( rc == 0 )) || exit 98
    done
  ' fixture "$ru" "$eu" "$rg" "$eg" || exit 97
}
run split-absent 3001 3002 3001 3002 4000,4001
run split-real-member 3001 3002 3001 3002 3001,3002,4000
run equal 3001 3001 3001 3001 3001,4000
run numeric 3001 3999 3001 3998 3001,4000
